verdict.rationale: Community users report a free tier, saying 'the 20 gigabyte they give you for free' and calling OneDrive 'free until it isn't.' First-party docs describe a single Microsoft Graph API and cross-device clients but never say these apply to a free tier. No first-party page publishes the free storage quota. missing for 10: first-party published free-tier storage quota, documentation that free accounts use the same sync clients and Graph API, independent corroboration of the quota figure.

support.subject: As a power user, I can start free — a real free tier with published storage quota that works with the same clients and API

citations.quote: the 20 gigabyte they give you for free doesn't cut it
